players.product: 300mm silicon wafers (Zing Semiconductor), 300mm SOI wafers (Simgui) and MEMS/specialty wafers (Okmetic)

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report: revenue RMB 231,724.48 ten-thousand, up 36.51% year over year (H1 2025: RMB 169,743.27 ten-thousand), an increase of RMB 6.2 hundred million driven by about RMB 6 hundred million more 300mm wafer revenue; net loss attributable to shareholders RMB 96,515.19 ten-thousand (H1 2025 loss: RMB 36,653.82 ten-thousand); net loss excluding non-recurring items RMB 95,763.26 ten-thousand; operating cash flow turned positive at RMB 17,898.75 ten-thousand. The company says 300mm wafer sales volume rose more than 90% but, with average prices still at a cyclical low after the 2023-2025 declines, 300mm revenue rose less than 60%; 200mm wafer volume rose about 16% but revenue less than 5%; contract processing revenue fell about 22% as demand has stayed low since Q2 2025. Unit costs fell markedly on scale and cost cutting, but gross profit did not improve significantly year over year. The wider loss reflects about RMB 1 hundred million more R&D on 300mm and 300mm SOI wafers, about RMB 2 hundred million higher finance costs from euro-renminbi exchange moves, and about RMB 1.2 hundred million higher asset impairment losses on inventory.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 231,724.48 ten-thousand (+36.51%); net loss RMB 96,515.19 ten-thousand; 300mm sales volume up more than 90%

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity at end-June 2026 (half-year report): combined 300mm wafer capacity in Shanghai and Taiyuan reached 100 ten-thousand wafers per month; 200mm-and-below polished and epitaxial wafer capacity (Simgui and Okmetic) above 50 ten-thousand wafers per month and 200mm-and-below SOI capacity above 6.5 ten-thousand wafers per month; subsidiary Xinao Xinyi has built a 300mm SOI pilot line of about 30 ten-thousand wafers per year. Zing Semiconductor kept 300mm utilisation and shipments high, with sales volume up more than 90% and revenue up 57%. The Taiyuan plant added 22 customers and 42 products in volume production in H1, with its prime-wafer ratio and prime-wafer sales rising quickly.
quarterly_data.figure: 300mm capacity 100 ten-thousand wafers/month; 300mm SOI pilot line about 30 ten-thousand wafers/year; Taiyuan +22 customers

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity targets (half-year report): the company expects its 300mm wafer capacity to reach 120 ten-thousand wafers per month by the end of 2026; phase one of Okmetic's 200mm specialty wafer expansion in Vantaa, Finland is basically complete and capacity is expected to be released gradually in H2 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 300mm capacity 120 ten-thousand wafers/month expected by end-2026

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Pricing outlook (half-year report): after 300mm wafer prices kept falling in 2023-2025, the domestic wafer market gradually stabilised and recovered in H1 2026; the company is pursuing price optimisation and negotiations by product specification, application and customer, and expects the related benefit to be released gradually in H2 2026. Short term it will push 300mm high-end capacity expansion and the Taiyuan ramp; medium term it targets AI computing, automotive electronics, energy storage, high-speed silicon photonics and big data with high-end specialty wafers, advanced SOI substrates and new piezoelectric film substrates.

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Overseas customers (half-year report): products, especially 300mm prime wafers, are supplied in volume to international customers (which include TSMC, UMC, STMicroelectronics and Vishay). Subsidiary Zing Semiconductor has qualified as a supplier to a leading European IDM (not named) and won high-end 300mm prime-wafer orders, and is qualifying <111> substrates for GaN-on-silicon and 300mm heavily doped wafers; 300mm and 200mm-and-below products have won business opportunities at major customers in the US, Japan / Korea and Europe.

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 300mm SOI and silicon photonics (half-year report): 300mm SOI wafers are in product validation, sampling and small-batch production; core 300mm SOI products for RF, high-voltage and silicon-photonics applications have completed key technology development and entered volume production, and products in early volume production are being further optimised; the company has also started pre-research for other advanced logic processes. R&D project status at end-June: 300mm silicon-photonics SOI wafer research (budget RMB 7,000.00 ten-thousand, RMB 4,080.37 ten-thousand invested) at sample development / customer sampling / small batch; layer-transfer silicon-photonics materials at customer sampling / small batch.
quarterly_data.figure: silicon-photonics SOI project RMB 4,080.37 ten-thousand invested of RMB 7,000.00 ten-thousand budget

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: During H1 2026 the company and Soitec deepened their strategic cooperation: on top of the existing licence and business cooperation, Soitec granted further SOI technology licences to subsidiaries Simgui and Xinao Xinyi to jointly promote SOI products in China (half-year report).

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other businesses (half-year report): subsidiary Xinsi Juhe's filter substrates are in volume production and shipping; R&D of optical-grade lithium niobate and lithium tantalate film substrates is complete and moved to volume production; 200mm single-crystal piezoelectric film substrate R&D is complete with batch deliveries; pre-research started on new substrates for high-frequency filters and high-speed optical communication chips. H1 2026 subsidiary results: Zing Semiconductor revenue RMB 166,426.06 ten-thousand, net loss RMB 45,245.48 ten-thousand; Simgui revenue RMB 29,551.17 ten-thousand, net loss RMB 14,395.11 ten-thousand; Okmetic revenue RMB 36,232.42 ten-thousand, net loss RMB 28,928.62 ten-thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Zing Semiconductor H1 revenue RMB 166,426.06 ten-thousand; Okmetic RMB 36,232.42 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (half-year report): H1 2026 R&D spending RMB 25,892.26 ten-thousand (+66.52%), 11.17% of revenue (9.16% a year earlier), driven by new 300mm wafer products and processes and by 300mm SOI development and sampling for RF, high-voltage and silicon-photonics uses; 117 products in development (43 300mm wafer and 34 300mm SOI products) and 79 newly developed products in validation.

quarterly_data.quarter: National Silicon Industry Group half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Construction in progress at end-June 2026 (half-year report): balance RMB 4,731,657,360.89. Major projects: Taiyuan 300mm wafer capacity-upgrade project budget RMB 910,000.00 ten-thousand, 63.21% complete; a Shanghai 300mm wafer capacity-upgrade project budget RMB 410,000.00 ten-thousand, 16.58% complete; 200mm specialty wafer expansion project budget RMB 299,000.00 ten-thousand, 79.28% complete; 300mm high-end silicon-based materials R&D pilot project budget RMB 214,420.80 ten-thousand, 48.24% complete.
